name: ShopBase
description: ShopBase is a comprehensive eCommerce platform designed to help businesses create and manage online stores with ease. It offers a range of tools for product management, order processing, and customer engagement, making it ideal for entrepreneurs and small to medium-sized businesses looking to establish a strong online presence.

events.d: Create a simple or multi-variant product with prices, SKUs, inventory, images, and tags.
Add a variant to a product with price, SKU, options, inventory, and shipping/tax details.
Add an image to a product from an image URL or base64 data. Optionally set filename, position, and alt text.
Retrieve details about the connected store.
Retrieve store orders using date ranges, status, customer, product, tracking number, and other filters.

Add a new customer with required first name and email, optional last name and phone, addresses (including province_code and country_code), marketing/tax/verified flags, currency, tags, notes, and default-address…
Delete an order from the store.
Remove a product from your store.

events.n: When a new product is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new product is created in the store.

events.n: When a new order is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new order is created in the store.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any product is updated in the store.

events.n: When a new customer is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new customer is created in the store.
Update a customer's profile, contact info, addresses, tags, and preferences.
Permanently remove a customer from the store. Fails if the customer is linked to existing orders.
Retrieve products from your ShopBase store using search terms, date or status filters, sorting, limits, and selected fields.
Retrieve customers from ShopBase, with optional created/updated date filters, limit, and selected fields.
